title: 🎓 Google gives $5 million to an Indian university to develop AI!
body: 🎓 Google gives $5 million to an Indian university to develop AI!

Google announced on 21 November a $5 million grant to the Indian Institute of Technology in the city of Kharagpur to support advanced AI research and develop the next generation of scientific and technical talent in India.
The funding goes to three main areas: advanced AI research, educational opportunities, and building technical capabilities inside the campus.

The research area includes applied projects tackling real challenges, such as developing AI for Indian languages, materials science, agriculture, and education technologies — fields that touch the lives of hundreds of millions of people in India.

The education area expands AI training programs and curriculum development for students, faculty members, and teachers, while the capacity-building area supports developing AI frameworks and tools inside the university to raise the technical level of the whole campus.

The announcement came during the institute's celebrations of 75 years since its founding, and Google CEO Sundar Pichai, himself a graduate of the institute, played a key role in facilitating this funding, according to the institute's director.

The new funding builds on an existing collaboration between Google and the institute as part of an initiative to prepare representative datasets, in a step that reflects a wider trend among major tech companies to invest in academic research outside America and China.

Simply put: $5 million for a prestigious Indian university to teach machines India's languages and improve its agriculture and education — can Arab universities attract similar funding from tech companies?
Do you think investing in university research matters more than investing in startups?
